facts.publicText: A competition prototype to which I contributed, combining text and voice interaction, route guidance, attraction narration, and knowledge management for a scenic-area visitor experience.
Prototype features include text and voice questions, speech playback, route guidance, narration, history, and feedback
The public source package excludes credentials, runtime data, logs, and third-party Live2D assets; it includes a static SVG guide fallback.
